tools.name: eliteextra_list_store_endpoints
tools.description: Map each store id of a multi-instance client to the EXTRA instance URL that holds it. Read-only. Vendor API: GET /x/api/store_lookup.

tools.name: eliteextra_list_customers
tools.description: List customer records of this site. Read-only. Vendor API: GET /x/api/customers.

tools.name: eliteextra_get_customer
tools.description: Get one customer record by id. Read-only. Vendor API: GET /x/api/customers/{id}.

tools.name: eliteextra_list_dealers
tools.description: List dealers (the branches or rental locations of the site). Read-only. Vendor API: GET /x/api/dealers.

tools.name: eliteextra_get_dealer
tools.description: Get one dealer by id. Read-only. Vendor API: GET /x/api/dealers/{id}.

tools.name: eliteextra_list_drivers
tools.description: List drivers of the site (the vendor returns 100 by default). Read-only. Vendor API: GET /x/api/drivers.

tools.name: eliteextra_get_driver
tools.description: Get one driver by id, optionally with related records (for example dealers). Read-only. Vendor API: GET /x/api/drivers/{id}.

tools.name: eliteextra_list_vehicles
tools.description: List vehicles (the fleet) of the site. Read-only. Vendor API: GET /x/api/vehicles.

tools.name: eliteextra_get_vehicle
tools.description: Get one vehicle by id, optionally with related records (for example dealer, rate). Read-only. Vendor API: GET /x/api/vehicles/{id}.

tools.name: eliteextra_list_vehicle_rates
tools.description: List the vehicle rates (price groups) of the site. Read-only. Vendor API: GET /x/api/vehiclerates.

tools.name: eliteextra_get_vehicle_rate
tools.description: Get one vehicle rate by id. Read-only. Vendor API: GET /x/api/vehiclerates/{id}.

tools.name: eliteextra_list_fuels
tools.description: List fuel records of the site. Read-only. Vendor API: GET /x/api/fuels.

tools.name: eliteextra_get_fuel
tools.description: Get one fuel record by id. Read-only. Vendor API: GET /x/api/fuels/{id}.

tools.name: eliteextra_list_orders
tools.description: List orders of the site, optionally filtered by invoice code. Read-only. Vendor API: GET /x/api/orders.

tools.name: eliteextra_list_order_status
tools.description: List order status records. With recents=true the vendor returns only changes since the last request, so a call can change what the next call returns. Read-only otherwise. Vendor API: GET /x/api/orderstatus.

tools.name: eliteextra_get_return
tools.description: Get one return order by id. Read-only. Vendor API: GET /x/api/returns/{id}.

tools.name: eliteextra_list_return_reasons
tools.description: List the reasons a return can carry. Read-only. Vendor API: GET /x/api/returns/reasons.
